definitions.explanation: The joint in the middle of the arm where it bends.

examples.japanese: {肘|ひじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つかないで→突く：12735_tsuku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't put your elbows on the table.

examples.japanese: {肘|ひじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げて→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{肘|ひじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつけて→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧⟦しまいました→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。

examples.english: Seeing the child put their elbow on the table, the mother said "Don't do that."

examples.japanese: ⟦テニス→テニス：01784_tenisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肘|ひじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}く→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Because I played tennis for a long time, my right elbow started hurting and I went to the hospital.

notes:
{肘|ひじ} is the elbow—the joint in the middle of the arm.

WRITING:
The kanji is complex, so hiragana (ひじ) is common in casual writing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {肘|ひじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げる→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧: to bend one's elbow
- {肘|ひじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つく→突く：12735_tsuku⟧: to put one's elbows (on table)
- {肘|ひじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつける→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧: to bump one's elbow
- ⟦{肘|ひじ}{掛|か}け→肘掛け：18182_hijikake⟧: armrest

MANNERS:
{肘|ひじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つく→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (putting elbows on the table) is considered bad manners in Japan, as in many cultures.
